turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen's mark. Why was a zero put in the gradebook before anyone called me?
An answer to what? I asked who decided on the zero, and you haven't told me.
Either Owen admits it in writing by Friday at 3 PM or the zero goes on his transcript.
A confession under a deadline. Admits what, exactly, and what document do you have?
Those are the only two options. Pick one.
Those are two options you invented. Check your own policy: it says you speak to the student first, and nobody did. Show me what you have, or I'm going to the principal.
